scope.summary: Implement PDF (print) export exposing its full enumerable panel surface as StudioExportRecipe executions: General (preset + PDF/X standard choice, compatibility version, pages/spreads, view/layout open settings, layer export, include bookmarks/hyperlinks/non-printing-objects/visible-guides-grids); Compression (per image class color/grayscale/monochrome downsampling method+threshold, codec JPEG/ZIP/JPEG2000/CCITT, quality tier, crop-to-frames); Marks & Bleeds (printer marks, bleed/slug inclusion); Output (color conversion none/convert-preserve-numbers, destination profile, PDF/X output intent, ink-manager access); Advanced (font-subsetting threshold, OPI omission, flattener preset); Security (open + permissions passwords, print/copy restrictions); Summary. Tagged/accessible PDF MUST be produced from style-to-tag mapping (MT-171), per-object alt text and roles, article/reading-order driven order, tab order, and document-title metadata. PDF/X intents + ink math driven by MT-188/14.8.
acceptance_criteria: full PDF panel surface as recipe + tagged/accessible PDF from style-tag mapping/alt-text/reading-order/metadata
proof_targets: headless PDF export runtime; tagged/accessible-PDF test
expected_tests: live: PDF export runs headlessly across all panels producing a valid PDF; security passwords + compression codecs applied
test: tagged/accessible PDF carries style-derived tags + alt text + reading order + tab order + document-title metadata

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / PDF export & accessible PDF

risk_if_missed: No PDF deliverable; accessible/tagged output impossible; primary publishing format missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
